messages.text:
Hi Alain and Hrushi,

Thank you for the time today. I'm looping in Dion here for vis.

While I am glad that Design/Dev are starting to work more in tandem, that call felt very challenging for me. My biggest challenge being that I felt we were truly wasting Matt’s time. He is very experienced in working with Dev teams and I’d appreciate if we can use our time in Design reviews going forward much more effectively and efficiently. While I understand that your team is incredibly busy, it seems as though there is a sentiment that Design changes are not a priority, which of course they very much are(!) and we certainly need to work together much more efficiently in order to hit upcoming deadlines.

As mentioned, the designs that Matt shared today will be built into a small prototype next week and will go through some User Testing. We’ll then iterate the designs according to feedback, all leading us towards our *March 2nd goal* of handing off new designs for Design/Explore and Onboarding to Dev*.* Updates to Component library will also start to take place as we go.

Here’s what I would love for next steps:

1. Dev to communicate if any elements of the new designs are entirely out of reach for March - ie. it sounds like populating a “Top Sources” statistic is out of reach
2. Communicate Dev *parameters* you need Design team to consider regarding proposed concepts - ie. how to populate the images for Trending Topics? etc. 
I would assume that it maybe easier for you all to consider the designs/limitations once the prototype is built next week but please feel free to <https://www.figma.com/design/kjUsvkiMGmZ2vGMMtPG0ru/Say-So--CALIBER-OWNED-?node-id=14561-39576&t=UFMXnByBDlgc0Rbc-1|poke around HERE> and leave comments (tag Caliber Design + Matt) in the mean time.
